content:
Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, we once again have some additional Apple Watch Ultra 4 models dropping back down to all-time low pricing at nearly $100 off and up to $200 off M5 MacBook Air. Today we spotted a rare MacBook Neo deal live at Amazon as well as up to $120 off select models directly on the Apple refurbished store, the 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio returning to the Amazon all-time low at $200 off, a chance to score the new Beats 360 at the lowest price we have seen yet, and the Beats 10-foot 240W Braided USB-C Cable at the lowest price of the year. Check it all out below.

Amazon’s AirPods Pro 3 deal is back at over 20% off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

New Apple Watch Ultra 4 just dropped back to all-time low at nearly $100 off [Updated] – Desert Alpine rare all-time low on medium size

We are catching some notable near-$100 price drops across the Apple Watch Ultra 4 lineup this week, delivering the return of all-time low pricing on several configurations. However, it can be extremely rare to see the medium-size band configs with price drops like this, and Apple’s Ultra 4 with that sweet new Desert Alpine band is also currently just shy of $100 off.

Again, there are several Ultra 4 options back at the Amazon all-time low pricing right now with the $99 price drop, and if this year is anything like last, this is indeed the Black Friday price – they could drop lower, of course, but the Ultra 3 maxed out at $100 off for most configs in 2025.

All of that said, most of the deals are for the large size bands, outside of this Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the Desert Alpine Loop at $699.99 shipped.

This one is also $99 off and sitting at the lowest price we have tracked since release in September.

The new Translucent Ocean Bands are admittedly calling my name this year, but I have always been a big fan of Apple’s Alpine Loop and still am – they seem to just fit with almost any occasion, save for something particularly formal, and just offer significantly more aesthetic interest compared to the Trail, for me anyway.

Either way though, there are various configs up for grabs at the lowest prices to date right now and you’ll find an updated list of them below – prices are bouncing around a bit, but we will keep a close eye on them:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Trail $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Desert Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Sand Trail $699 (Reg. $799)

Rare MacBook Neo deal live at Amazon, or $120 off straight from Apple refurb

While it’s certainly not a giant discount by any means, but if there was any Mac that wasn’t going to get a deep Black Friday deal it would probably be the MacBook Neo – the most affordable model is now sitting down at one of the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon since the price increase this past summer.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch MacBook Neo 256GB model down at $669.22 shipped. The Silver and Indigo models are still up closer to full list, but you will find the vibrant Citrus model and the Blush at the discounted rate.

Again, this is a regularly $699 machine so we aren’t talking about a huge deal here, but price drops of any kind on MacBook Neo have been somewhere between extremely light and non existent. This is actually a solid deal all things considered, even though it’s really only $30 off, but you might as well keep some lunch money in your pocket if you’re looking to get one under the tree this year.

The lowest price, however, from the best possible source is currently available over on the official Apple refurb store. While stock is very limited over there, as per usual, you can score the Neo as low as $599

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

These machines ship with:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

Apple’s 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio returns to Amazon all-time low at $200 off, M6 mini from $779

Pre-orders are live ahead of release this month for the new M6 MacBook Pro, M6 iMac, and the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display. We also have up to $150 off the 2026 Mac mini lineup and Amazon has just brought back the $200 price drop on Apple’s latest M5 Max Mac Studio.

While the M6 Mac mini lineup, or even the M5 Pro model, will likely suffice for most home studios, personal local AI setups, and workstations, those looking for a more pro-grade rig might want to look towards the 36GB M5 Max Mac Studio while it’s $200 off at Amazon.

This is the most affordable configuration in the lineup with 36GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD alongside the 18-core CPU and 32-core GPU down at $2,299 shipped.

Regularly $2,499, this is the same Amazon all-time low price we featured previously, but after quickly jumping back up to full list, Amazon is bringing it back down to kick off Black Friday month.

We first saw this deal land in and around the fall Prime Day sale, and it has largely remained available since then. But after it appeared as though Amazon was gonna pull the discount as we moved into November, we wanted to make sure folks looking to go pro had this one on their radar.

For the rest of us, the mini is likely more than powerful enough:

  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $779 (Reg. $899)
  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $949 (Reg. $1,099)
  • M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (Reg. $1,699)

Lowest prices yet on new Beats 360 Headphones, Best Buy ‘excellent’ open-box up to $80 off

Outside of a light $30 price drop on the black set and the launch deal on the Cushion Kits, we are yet to track a particularly substantial deal on the new Beats 360 modular ANC headphones. Best Buy, however, does have some early “excellent” condition open-box units now available at up to $81 off the new prices. Details below.

Still up at the full $349 via Amazon, you’ll find the now live Best Buy open-box unit deals below:

  • Beats 360 Headphones Black $269 (Reg. $350)
  • Beats 360 Headphones Sky $276 (Reg. $350)
  • Beats 360 Headphones Cloud $302 (Reg. $350)

Considering how new the Beats 360 are, stock quantities are likely to be low on the “excellent” condition open-box units listed above.

As mentioned, we did catch a light $30 price drop on the new condition Black set over at Amazon last week that has now come and gone, but that is the only straight cash discount we have tracked to date.

Black Friday is looming, and Beats gear is no stranger to holiday discounts – there is loads of it on sale already at Amazon, but it’s hard to say how things will go with the new 360. Something like $30 or $50 off isn’t out of the question, but it’s hard to imagine them dropping down much lower than that this soon after release. Only time will tell of course, but if you are looking to land a set now these Best Buy prices are the best we have seen to date from a reputable source.
